summary: Extended engine/fleet.ts with upsertFleetEntry (keyed by poolDir, recreates missing/corrupt files) and prune-on-read readFleetEntries; createPoolServer now resolves poolDir and upserts its {poolDir,port,pid,startedAt} entry after a successful bind, best-effort so registry failures never brick a bound console. Added module-seam tests in fleet.test.ts (live process.pid and spawned-reaped spare pids) and a fleet-registration block in server.test.ts; all booting server tests use a temp registry path. 177 tests, typecheck, and UI build clean.
